title: perf(spec): check:liveness reads each cited file once per run
body:
Part of #23180

Clause-②: no

**This PR takes no row off the card.** Both of the card's dominant `@objectstack/spec` rows stay over the 10 s per-file budget after it, and the card stays open for both:

- `scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts` (`local` project) drops from about 190 to 255 s to about 87 to 101 s locally: 2.2x to 2.9x, still about 9x over.
- `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` (`repo` project) is untouched, at about 900 s.

The measured floors for both files are in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card, along with why neither can reach 10 s without weakening what it proves. The seat's decision on that report is to land this speed-up and send the budget question for this class of self-test to the maintainer.

Dispatched by the `domain:spec` seat 4 PM (`sunhaolin`), claim comment 6175077909, branch `claude/issue-23180-spec-slowest-two`.

## What changed

`packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts` is the only file changed (+21/-6):

- `lineCountOf` and `contentOf` now read a cited file through one per-run memo, `readCited`. It is keyed by the repo-relative path, and a missing file is memoized as missing.
- Before, every citation re-read its file. One gate run read 455.8 MB in 2,367 reads over 828 files; `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` alone was read 142 times. That was nearly half of each run's wall, and the self-test pays it on every one of its roughly 66 gate spawns.
- After, one run reads 30.5 MB.
- Nothing in the repo changes during one gate run, so the memo cannot change a verdict. The equivalence readings below measure that.

## Readings

All readings are local, taken through `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c` (each `VERDICT command-exit 0`). They are shared-box seconds: the lock excludes only other locked runs, so ratios are the robust part.

**The self-test file**, as the vitest `default` reporter's module line (the number the full battery records). Command:

```
env -u AI_AGENT -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE -u CURSOR_AGENT NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts --reporter=default
```

| tree | run 1 | run 2 | run 3 | cases |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| before: the gate at `0be162c75d` | 190.5 s | 255.3 s | 251.3 s | 71/71 pass |
| after: the memo at `f6bcfe9c91` | 87.1 s | 87.4 s | 90.0 s | 71/71 pass |
| after: this head, merged with `origin/main` `b1cfa3d263` | 97.4 s | 93.8 s | 101.3 s | 71/71 pass |

CI's reading before was 493.4 s, in run `38332198724`. The CI reading after is NOT MEASURED until the next refresh window lists this file again.

**One `check-liveness.mts` run.** This is what `pnpm check:liveness` pays on every lint run, and what the self-test pays per spawn:

| comparison | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the gate at `0be162c75d` vs the memo at `f6bcfe9c91` | 3.84 to 4.20 s | 1.23 to 1.34 s |
| `origin/main`'s gate vs this head's gate, on this head's tree | 3.02 to 3.49 s | 1.37 to 1.45 s |

**The same verdicts.** `origin/main`'s gate (a temporary untracked copy beside this one, deleted after) and this head's gate were run on the same tree. Their output is byte-identical:

- default mode: 6,514 bytes, exit 0 on both;
- `--json` mode: 55,633 bytes, exit 0 on both.

**The same assertions.** `check-liveness.test.ts` is not edited. Every assertion is the one on `main`, and all 71 pass.

## Ablation: the self-test still catches a broken memo

The mutation keys `readCited` by basename, so two different cited files collide, for example `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` and `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`. It was applied with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and its `-- CMD` form, which arms the restore before it writes:

- **Mutation:** anchor count 1 to 0, blob `141dc51f5a62` to `835c251a41e2`. On-disk counts: injected marker 1, removed `citedText.set(p, text);` 0.
- **Mutant self-test:** exit 1, **24 of 71 cases red.**
  - The green controls exit 1 instead of 0. On the verbatim-copy control, the gate reports `✗ 57 anchored citation(s) name a symbol the cited file does not contain` and `✗ 22 ... citation(s) name a file that never names the property`.
  - The anchor case `FAILS when an anchored symbol is gone ...` misses its exact `✗ 1 anchored citation(s)` count.
- **Restore:** `blob == HEAD` (`141dc51f5a62`), `git diff HEAD` empty, porcelain clean, marker count 0.
- The source is run directly by tsx, so there is no `dist/` in the path.

## Why it stops here

**`build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts`:**

- Each of its 88 cases runs the real generator on its own fixture: about 96 runs at 8.5 to 9.0 s warm.
- Most of each run is Zod `toJSONSchema` over about 1,700 schemas, plus git and an output rewrite.
- The median case alone takes 9.07 s.

**`check-liveness.test.ts`:**

- Its floor is about 43 distinct one-cause fixtures times one gate run.
- An in-process route measured about 7.4 s locally with zero margin, and it reverses the file's spawn-the-real-gate design.
- Sharing the identical-state runs inside the test is left out: a case would read another case's run, and the file's own hook-budget block scans `runGate`'s reach to `spawnSync`.

## Changeset

None, because nothing publishes.

- `packages/spec`'s `files[]` does not list `scripts/`.
- Measured on the packed tarball (`pnpm pack` after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, 2,091 files):
  - no `scripts/` path;
  - 0 files contain `readCited`, `citedText` or the pre-existing gate-only `EVIDENCE_SCANNED_STATUSES`;
  - positive control: `listMetadataTypeSchemaTypes` is in 14 files.
- Hence `skip-changeset`.

## Gates

Derived at this head (`62adc640c1`) with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 55 commands. All 55 were run, with each exit code captured before any pipe. The `--ran` reconciliation reads `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 53 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, 0 UNRUN.

- **53 exit 0.** These include `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:published-files`, `check:closing-keyword-parity` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates`.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`.** Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. They load other packages' built `dist/` entries, and only `@objectstack/spec` was built locally. Neither can read an unshipped file under `packages/spec/scripts/`. CI runs both.
- **Changeset readings beyond the derivation, all exit 0:** `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` and `pnpm check:published-files`.

## Acceptance notes

- Option D from the report, a ruling on the 10 s line for gate self-tests that spawn the real gate once per one-cause fixture, is the maintainer's. It is not part of this PR.
- The merge commits from `origin/main` carry git's default message.
